name: Prodiseum – Flexible Shipping Rules for WooCommerce
author: prodiseum

sections.description:
Regula gives WooCommerce stores a visual way to create practical shipping-cost rules without editing code.

The free edition includes:

  • Fixed shipping cost by product, variation or product category.
  • Per-unit shipping cost using the Multiply by quantity option.
  • Percentage-based shipping cost using product value and purchased quantity.
  • Quantity-range shipping costs.
  • First-unit plus additional-unit shipping costs.
  • One searchable target field for products, variations and categories.
  • Multiple products, variations and categories in the same rule.
  • Optional inclusion of category subcategories.
  • Priority levels from 1 to 10.
  • Equal-priority rules are accumulated automatically.
  • Optional Add behaviour for lower-priority rules that should also contribute.
  • Optional tax calculation on the generated shipping fee lines.
  • Optional hiding of standard WooCommerce shipping when Regula is used on its own.

Each calculated product shipping cost is shown as a separate line in the cart and checkout totals.

Regula requires WooCommerce. The free plugin does not contain locked premium functionality and does not send store, customer or usage data to Prodiseum Digital Dynamics or third-party services.

Regula Pro

Regula Pro is a separate plugin for stores that need more advanced logistics rules. It adds weight ranges, volume/dimension ranges, cart-subtotal ranges, destination rules by country/state/postcode, a free-shipping threshold, and minimum/maximum shipping-cost limits.

More information: https://prodiseum.com/regula

Support and contact: info@prodiseum.com
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Regula from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin ZIP.
  3. Activate Regula.
  4. Go to Prodiseum > Regula > Shipping Rules.
  5. Create the rules you need and save them.
  6. Use Prodiseum > Regula > Settings for the WooCommerce shipping/tax integration options.
sections.faq:
Is the free edition limited by number of products or rules?

No. Regula Free does not impose artificial product-count or rule-count limits.

Can one rule target a complete WooCommerce category?

Yes. Search for the category in the same target field used for products and variations. You can also include its subcategories.

Can I target a specific product variation?

Yes. Variations appear in the same searchable target field and can have their own rule configuration.

How do I create a cost per unit?

Create a fixed-cost rule and enable Multiply by quantity. A cost of 5 with a cart quantity of 3 produces a shipping cost of 15 for that product line.

What happens when several rules match the same product?

Priority 1 is the highest and priority 10 is the lowest. Matching rules with the same priority are added together. Lower-priority rules are ignored unless the lower-priority rule has Add enabled.

Does Regula replace WooCommerce shipping methods?

Regula adds calculated shipping costs as fee lines. If you do not use native WooCommerce shipping methods, you can enable the option to hide the standard shipping section.

What does Regula Pro add?

Regula Pro adds weight and volume ranges, subtotal ranges, destination rules, free-shipping thresholds and minimum/maximum fee limits. It is distributed separately from the free plugin.

Does Regula send data to an external service?

No. The free plugin does not send store, customer or usage data to Prodiseum Digital Dynamics or third-party services.

1.0.14

  • Removed bundled PO, MO and POT translation files so translations are handled through translate.wordpress.org.
  • Removed the no-longer-needed Domain Path header while keeping all source strings internationalized with the WordPress.org text domain.

  • No shipping-rule functionality was changed.

1.0.12

  • Added the required translator comments for dynamic “Open %s” admin strings reported by Plugin Check.
  • No shipping-rule functionality was changed.

  • Added a WordPress product/variation search fallback when WooCommerce or third-party search filters return no product results.

  • Registered Regula in the Prodiseum Dashboard with its official plugin icon, edition and version information.
  • Bundled the shared Prodiseum dashboard assets so Regula can provide the hub even when it is the only Prodiseum plugin installed.

1.0.8

  • Standardized all shipping-rule table columns to left alignment for a consistent admin interface.
  • Aligned Priority fields, Add checkboxes, Multiply by quantity checkboxes and Remove actions with their column headings.

1.0.7

  • Tightened table-column alignment again so Priority inputs, Add checkboxes, Multiply by quantity checkboxes and Remove buttons sit visually centered under their headers.
  • Added stronger admin CSS rules for checkbox cells and action cells to improve consistency across WordPress admin styles.

1.0.6

  • Refined admin-table alignment so Add and Multiply by quantity checkboxes sit correctly centered under their column headings.
  • Improved the Remove action column width and button centering for a cleaner, more consistent interface.

1.0.5

  • Removed direct page-query inspection from the admin asset loader.
  • Admin styles and scripts are now scoped using the hook suffixes returned by WordPress when the Regula admin pages are registered.
  • This resolves the Plugin Check nonce-verification warnings without changing plugin functionality.

1.0.4

  • Updated the bundled Regula logo so all branding is fully in English.
  • Added an in-plugin call-to-action banner below the free rule sections linking to the Regula website.
  • Updated the Regula Pro website link to https://prodiseum.com/regula.

1.0.3

  • Renamed the public plugin title to Regula Shipping Rules so it matches the WordPress.org slug and text domain.
  • Removed the generic Plugin URI from the plugin header; the author website remains available through Author URI.
  • Refreshed translation metadata for the submission-ready package.

1.0.2

  • Added first-unit plus additional-unit pricing to the free edition for products, variations and categories.
  • Moved Regula to its own top-level WordPress admin menu with Shipping Rules, Settings and Free vs Pro submenus.
  • Moved WooCommerce integration options to the dedicated Settings screen.
  • Expanded the rule editor to use the available admin width and improved table header alignment and spacing.

1.0.1

  • Removed the no-longer-needed manual text-domain loader for WordPress.org language packs.
  • Sanitized submitted rule rows recursively before processing.

1.0.0

  • First WordPress.org-ready free release.
  • Added fixed and per-unit shipping costs by product, variation or category.
  • Added percentage-based shipping costs.
  • Added quantity-range shipping costs.
  • Added unified product, variation and category targeting with multiple selections.
